title: Onboarding warning skips silently when the community lease is busy
current: processDueOnboardingReminder returns notDue() when the community-wide lease is busy, with no log, so a repeatedly starved warning looks the same as one that isn't due.
evidence: `if (error instanceof CommunityGoalMutationInProgressError) return notDue();` — same pattern as R-W5-03 for the onboarding goal.
required: An info skip line with reason lock_busy (the #237 lease logs will also name the holder).

criticality.why: Self-recovering, but starvation would be invisible.
